source_caption:
🎬 The Slammin’ Salmon (2009)

The Slammin’ Salmon follows Cleon Salmon, a hot-tempered former heavyweight boxing champion who now owns an upscale seafood restaurant in Miami. When Cleon finds himself desperately needing $20,000 to settle a debt, he challenges his restaurant staff to earn as much money as possible in a single night, promising a cash prize to the highest-selling waiter and threatening the lowest performer with serious consequences. What begins as a simple competition quickly turns into a chaotic evening filled with outrageous customers, ridiculous misunderstandings, workplace rivalries, and hilarious disasters. As the employees desperately compete to impress their demanding boss, the restaurant becomes a battlefield of unpredictable comedy. Starring Michael Clarke Duncan and the Broken Lizard comedy troupe, the film delivers wild humor, unforgettable characters, and nonstop restaurant chaos.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Workplace Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 6.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 30m • R

🎥 Director: Kevin Heffernan

✍️ Writers: Broken Lizard

source_details.synopsis: The Slammin' Salmon is a 2009 American comedy film by the comedy troupe Broken Lizard. It is about the owner of a restaurant who holds a contest to see which one of his waiters can earn the most money in a single night. The winner receives $10,000, and the loser receives a "beat down" by the owner, Cleon Salmon, a former heavyweight boxer (played by Michael Clarke Duncan). Kevin Heffernan directed the film, his first time for a Broken Lizard film.
